products.description: Have your little one rooting for their favorite team when you wear the '47 Kids' Arkansas Razorbacks Clean Up Cap. It is made of garment washed cotton twill. The raised embroidery Arkansas Razorbacks logo on the front, and its self fabric strap creates an adjustable wear. The relaxed fit can be worn casually.
